source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Record the location of the appliance.
3. Document the name and serial number of the appliance.
4. Collect the make, model, and any warranty information.
5. Record the date and time of the safety check.
6. Be specific about each test or check that was conducted.
7. Note any discrepancies found during the inspection.
8. Photograph any defects, damage, or potential safety hazards.
9. Indicate the cause of failure with as much detail as possible.
10. Provide recommendations for correction if applicable.
11. Include any comments or observations from the tester.
12. State the necessary course of action, such as repair or replacement.
13. Record the tester's name, title, and certification (if relevant).
14. Keep all documentation organized and readily accessible.
15. Ensure secure storage of records for future reference and any potential legal requirements.
16. Attach all relevant documentation to the appliance's service history file.
17. Maintain a digital copy
